title: Calycosin inhibited MIF-mediated inflammatory chemotaxis of macrophages to ameliorate ischemia reperfusion-induced acute kidney injury.
authors: Wang, Hong-Lian; Peng, Ze; Li, Yu-Qing; Wang, Yi-Xuan; Li, Jian-Chun; Tan, Rui-Zhi; Su, Hong-Wei; Shen, Hong-Ping; Zhao, Chang-Ying; Liu, Jian; Wang, Li
journal: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
one_liner_zh: 该文研究毛蕊异黄酮通过抑制MIF介导的巨噬细胞炎症趋化改善缺血再灌注肾损伤，核心为小分子-蛋白互作与炎症机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inflammatory macrophage infiltration plays a critical role in acute kidney disease induced by ischemia-reperfusion (IRI-AKI). Calycosin is a natural flavone with multiple bioactivities. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic role of calycosin in IRI-AKI and its underlying mechanism. METHODS: The renoprotective and anti-inflammatory effects of calycosin were analyzed in C57BL/6 mice with IRI-AKI and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells. RNA-seq was used for mechanism investigation. The molecular target of calycosin was screened by in silico methods and validated by surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Macrophage chemotaxis was analyzed using Transwell and agarose gel spot assays. RESULTS: Calycosin treatment significantly reduced serum creatinine and urea nitrogen and attenuated tubular destruction in IRI-AKI mice. Additionally, calycosin markedly suppressed NF-kappaB signaling activation and the expression of inflammatory mediators IL-1beta and TNF-alpha in IRI-AKI kidneys and LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells. Interestingly, RNA-seq revealed calycosin remarkably downregulated chemotaxis-related pathways in RAW 264.7 cells. Among the differentially expressed genes, Ccl2/MCP-1, a critical chemokine mediating macrophage inflammatory chemotaxis, was downregulated in both LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells and IRI-AKI kidneys. Consistently, calycosin treatment attenuated macrophage infiltration in the IRI-AKI kidneys. Importantly, in silico target prediction, molecular docking, and SPR assay demonstrated that calycosin directly binds to macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF). Functionally, calycosin abrogated MIF-stimulated NF-kappaB signaling activation and Ccl2 expression and MIF-mediated chemotaxis in RAW 264.7 cells. CONCLUSIONS: In summary, calycosin attenuates IRI-AKI by inhibiting MIF-mediated macrophage inflammatory chemotaxis, suggesting it could be a promising therapeutic agent for the treatment of IRI-AKI.
abstract_zh: 背景：炎症性巨噬细胞浸润在缺血再灌注诱导的急性肾损伤（IRI-AKI）中发挥关键作用。毛蕊异黄酮（calycosin）是一种具有多种生物活性的天然黄酮类化合物。本研究旨在探讨毛蕊异黄酮在IRI-AKI中的治疗作用及其潜在机制。方法：在C57BL/6小鼠IRI-AKI模型和脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW 264.7细胞中分析毛蕊异黄酮的肾脏保护和抗炎作用。采用RNA-seq进行机制研究。通过计算机模拟方法筛选毛蕊异黄酮的分子靶点，并利用表面等离子体共振（SPR）进行验证。使用Transwell和琼脂糖凝胶斑点实验分析巨噬细胞趋化性。结果：毛蕊异黄酮处理显著降低IRI-AKI小鼠的血清肌酐和尿素氮，并减轻肾小管破坏。此外，毛蕊异黄酮显著抑制IRI-AKI肾脏和LPS刺激的RAW 264.7细胞中NF-kappaB信号通路激活及炎症介质IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的表达。有趣的是，RNA-seq揭示毛蕊异黄酮在RAW 264.7细胞中显著下调趋化相关通路。在差异表达基因中，Ccl2/MCP-1（一种介导巨噬细胞炎症趋化的关键趋化因子）在LPS刺激的RAW 264.7细胞和IRI-AKI肾脏中均被下调。一致地，毛蕊异黄酮处理减弱了IRI-AKI肾脏中的巨噬细胞浸润。重要的是，计算机模拟靶点预测、分子对接和SPR实验证明毛蕊异黄酮直接结合巨噬细胞迁移抑制因子（MIF）。在功能上，毛蕊异黄酮消除了MIF刺激的NF-kappaB信号通路激活和Ccl2表达，以及RAW 264.7细胞中MIF介导的趋化作用。结论：总之，毛蕊异黄酮通过抑制MIF介导的巨噬细胞炎症趋化减轻IRI-AKI，表明其可能成为治疗IRI-AKI的有前景的治疗药物。
